Local/farm obligation and combination diagnosis lists are not themselves an authority stage assessment; their presence/absence and known evidence cannot be inferred from the payable number alone. findings.impact: Caller must preserve diagnosis/recognition/evidence and actual authorization state alongside monetary components. This is not a claim that each local breach demands100percent reduction, that a diagnostic computation is an unlawful payment, or that a unique monetary reverse oracle is known. Root owns this remaining cross-cutting output boundary; general/measure own their actual local consumers.
